title: How this book works
summary: Every rule has an address. Quote the address, not the page.

title: What is provisional in this version
summary: Everything in this book is written as a rule. Six items are still decisions in progress, and they are named here rather than hidden.

title: Where NEWGEN comes from
summary: NEWGEN Event Studio began in 2018 with one belief: a celebration should look, on the day, exactly the way it looked in the mind of the person who imagined it.

title: Promise and tagline
summary: The brand promise and the tagline are locked. Use both verbatim in formal material. Never paraphrase, shorten or restyle them.

title: Personality, as evidence
summary: NEWGEN is premium, visionary and trustworthy. Each word is a claim, so each one is paired with something a guest, a venue or a printer can actually see.

title: Three differentiators
summary: Three things set NEWGEN apart. Lead with them in that order, and let the first one carry the most weight.

title: The only numbers we use
summary: Six facts are approved for public use. Nothing outside this table appears on any NEWGEN material, ever.

title: The primary mark
summary: The Crown Pillar is the signature of NEWGEN. It is always reproduced from the master artwork, in one of the approved colours, and never altered.

title: What the mark is made of
summary: Three elements, one gesture. Know them by name, because production conversations refer to them.

title: Construction and the unit X
summary: The mark is measured in one unit, X: the height of the crown, from the tip of the flame to the underside of the deepam cap. Every spacing rule in this book is written in X.

title: Clear space
summary: Keep a clear zone of at least X on every side of the mark, and of the full lockup. Nothing enters it.

title: Minimum sizes
summary: The full mark holds down to 16 pixels. No simplified variant exists, and none should be drawn.

title: Approved lockups
summary: Six forms are approved. Choose by the space and by what sits behind, never by taste.

title: Colour versions and the background matrix
summary: Three colour versions exist: teal, gold and cream. Which one you use is decided by the background, using this table.
tags: I want to put the logo on a photograph

title: The gap, and production tolerances
summary: The gap between the swoosh and the pillar is intentional. It must never close, and it must never taper to a knife point. Its width stays constant along its whole length.
tags: The logo is being embroidered, foiled or engraved

title: Never redraw
summary: The mark is only ever reproduced from the supplied artwork. It is never redrawn, retraced, retyped or rebuilt, by anyone, for any reason.
tags: I am sending logo files to a printer, a vendor or ISCL

title: Misuse
summary: Eight things that happen to logos. None of them happens to this one.

title: Container forms: the card and the solid mark
summary: When the logo cannot trust what is behind it, it brings its own surface. Two forms do that job, and they are not interchangeable.

title: The palette
summary: Five colours. Gold carries the brand emotionally, teal grounds it, cream gives it room, ochre points, ruby punctuates.

title: Values
summary: One table, four systems. Screen uses HEX and RGB. Print uses CMYK for process and Pantone for spot. Create exactly these eight swatches in every working file.
tags: I am printing something and need CMYK or Pantone

title: Hierarchy and proportion
summary: Gold is used most. Teal second. Cream is the ground. Ochre is an accent only. Ruby is one small focal element per touchpoint, never a base colour. Black is never a dominant colour.
tags: I need to choose a colour for a highlight or a button

title: Contrast: pairs that pass and pairs that do not
summary: Text is set only in pairs that reach 4.5 to 1. Large text and the mark may use 3 to 1. Anything below 3 to 1 is decoration and never carries words.

title: Print notes
summary: Colour is approved on paper, under a fixed light, from a physical proof. Never from a screen and never from a vendor's PDF.

title: Two families, three roles
summary: Cormorant Garamond Bold carries the wordmark and every headline. Futura PT Light, widely tracked, carries the descriptor and every label. Cormorant italic carries the tagline and nothing else.

title: Hierarchy and scale
summary: Six roles. Every piece of NEWGEN text is one of them.

title: Substitutes, and what is never used
summary: When the licensed faces are unavailable, use Cormorant, Jost Light and Inter from Google Fonts. Nothing else, and never a decorative script.

title: Tamil, and the bilingual setting
summary: Neither brand face carries Tamil glyphs. Tamil is set in Noto Sans Tamil, size-matched to Futura, and every ceremony name appears in both languages.

title: Setting text
summary: Short declarative sentences. Numbers over adjectives. Sentence case for every title. No em dashes anywhere, and no exclamation marks.

title: The kolam master tile
summary: One square tile, drawn as a single unbroken line. It repeats on a grid with zero spacing. It is never redrawn, only placed.

title: Colourways
summary: Three colourways. Gold on teal is primary. Gold on cream is secondary. Teal on cream is tertiary. No fourth.
tags: I want to use the kolam pattern on something

title: Scale and placement
summary: The pattern is texture, not decoration. It sits behind, at the edge, or at a corner. It never competes with the mark and never fills a page at full strength.
tags: I want to use the kolam pattern on something

title: Illustration and icons
summary: Illustration is cut from the kolam lattice, never bought as generic spot art. Icons come from one geometric family at one stroke weight.

title: What a NEWGEN photograph is
summary: Real work, actually delivered, photographed with the hall as the subject. Warm, natural colour. Never stock, never illustrated, never generated.

title: The mandatory shots
summary: Five frames per event, minimum, in this order. A photographer who leaves without them is called back.
tags: I am choosing photographs for the website or Instagram

title: Enhance, never regenerate
summary: Exposure, white balance, crop and noise may be corrected. Nothing may be added, removed or regenerated. A photograph that has been generatively altered is not a NEWGEN photograph.
tags: I am choosing photographs for the website or Instagram

title: People, faces and the photographer brief
summary: No identifiable guest faces without written consent. Crew and the founder may appear. Every hired photographer receives the one-page brief on this spread.

title: The voice in one line
summary: NEWGEN speaks the way Mohan works: it sketches before it sells, and it never oversells what it cannot deliver.

title: Five principles
summary: Each principle is shown as a bad line and a good line, because the difference is easier to hear than to explain.

title: Sentence mechanics and word choice
summary: No em dashes. No exclamation marks. No rhetorical questions in headlines. Never the word "unmistakably". Short declarative sentences. Numbers wherever a real number exists.

title: Register by audience
summary: One voice, six registers. Know who is reading before writing a word.
tags: I am writing a caption, a WhatsApp reply or an Instagram post

title: Caption framework
summary: Five caption shapes, one per channel. Copy the shape, change the facts.
tags: I am writing a caption, a WhatsApp reply or an Instagram post

title: How applications are specified
summary: Every application is drawn as a flat technical elevation: hairline teal outline on cream, colour only where the brand sits, lettered callouts, real dimensions in millimetres. A vendor builds from the page without a phone call.

title: Stationery
summary: Business card, letterhead, quotation and invoice share one system: teal field with the pattern, cream working area, gold mark, ruby gem, one line of contact detail in Futura.

title: Digital
summary: The mark alone is the display picture everywhere. Gold on teal for the studio, and a small letter or icon badge for each role account. The wordmark is never used as a display picture: it is illegible at that size.
tags: I am making a WhatsApp post, a display picture or a status

title: Signboard and name board
summary: Teal field, gold lockup, the tagline optional, cream contact line on the bottom edge. Display weight only: no thin serif strokes at this scale.
tags: I am ordering uniforms, ID cards or a signboard

title: Vehicles
summary: Vehicle branding is read in two to three seconds at speed. Mark, wordmark and one phone number, large, on a teal panel. No tagline, no motif detail, no service list.

title: Staff and operational
summary: ID card, lanyard and uniform carry the mark in single colour. The thank-you card is the one operational piece that earns a sentence.
tags: I am ordering uniforms, ID cards or a signboard

title: Beside other marks
summary: When the NEWGEN mark sits beside a venue, a partner or a league, both marks keep their own clear space, sit on one baseline, and are separated by a vertical hairline. Neither is taller than the other by more than 20 percent.

title: The partnership, and why this annexe exists
summary: NEWGEN Event Studio is the Official Travel Partner of Chola Kings, Tamil Nadu, in the Indian Softball Cricket League. The mark will appear on a jersey, a team bus, 127 boundary boards and 14 broadcast spots on Sony Sports Network.

title: The partnership lockup
summary: One approved lockup carries the association: NEWGEN lockup, hairline divider, Chola Kings mark, and the designation line beneath. Nothing enters the isolation zone, and neither mark is scaled against the other beyond 20 percent.

title: Boundary board
summary: Teal field, the lockup in gold at 80 percent of board height on the left third, NEWGEN repeated large in the right two thirds. No tagline, no phone number, no pattern. The ruby gem is dropped: at this distance it reads as dirt.
tags: I need to put the logo on a jersey, a bus or a boundary board

title: Jersey shoulder
summary: Mark alone, single colour, on the shoulder panel, 40 mm minimum height. Embroidered wherever ISCL allows it. The gap between swoosh and pillar is called out to the supplier at 1.2 mm minimum.
tags: I need to put the logo on a jersey, a bus or a boundary board

title: Team bus, and broadcast
summary: Bus: a 300 mm teal patch on the rear quarter panel, gold lockup, cut vinyl. Broadcast: the distance variant from A.3, on screen for no less than 2 seconds at no less than 8 percent of frame height, inside the title-safe area.
tags: I need to put the logo on a jersey, a bus or a boundary board

title: What ISCL receives, and what it does not
summary: Third parties receive production formats only. The master files never leave the studio. Every delivery carries a one-page specification sheet.
tags: I am sending logo files to a printer, a vendor or ISCL

title: Versions, files and decisions
summary: This is version 0.1, dated 6 September 2026. It supersedes every earlier logo, colour, type or pattern decision. When a rule needs to bend, it is raised with Eswar Creatives, decided with Mohan A and MD ma'am, and written into the next version.

summary: One page for the crew and the printer. The rules that actually get broken, in the language the crew speaks. Cut it out, laminate it, keep it in the van.
